summary.en: A Phaser-built Slither.io-style snake arena, complete with server code and a written tutorial series.
summary.zh: 贪吃蛇大作战的 Phaser 复刻，含服务端与教程文档。

description.en: Steer with the mouse and vacuum up glowing dots to grow. Bait rivals into ramming your body, then absorb what's left of them — the feast never really ends.
description.zh: 鼠标控制蛇的方向，吃光点变长；让别人撞上你的身体即可击杀并吞掉对方光点，越吃越长。

tip.en: The author documented the whole build as a tutorial series — working through it teaches you Phaser plus netcode. It needs a Node server, so deployment costs more than a static game.
tip.zh: 作者把实现过程写成了系列教程，跟着做一遍能掌握 Phaser + 联机同步。需 Node 服务端，部署成本高于静态游戏。
